messages:
maria: Starting Pegasus LoRA adapter onboarding. Adapter uploaded to s3://pegasus-adapters/cust_pegasus_v2.safetensors. Need a quick compat + 4-bit quant sanity run before handing to Solutions. Plan: targeted quickpack (decode-heavy + short completions). @chris @sam any concerns?

chris: +1. Add a short-completion prompt set and one long-context case. Also be mindful of RoPE scale drift — adapter notes say rotary_scale=1.02.

sam: I'll try additive merge first (no stitch). If we see generation collapse we'll attempt stitch. Running on a small A10G to keep cost down. Command I'm going to run:
```
python infra/eval/run_quick_eval.py \
  --base pegasus-base-7b \
  --adapter s3://pegasus-adapters/cust_pegasus_v2.safetensors \
  --merge additive \
  --quant 4bit \
  --prompts eval_packs/pegasus_decode_short.json \
  --out /tmp/pegasus_quick_1800123456.json \
  --batch 4
```

anika: FYI the fine-tune used rotary_scale=1.02 and relative RoPE tweaks. If you see length-dependent truncation set PRESERVE_ROPE_SCALE=1.02 at merge time.

chris: Also turn off prefix-preserving cache for the smoke. Set REDWOOD_CACHE_PREFIX=false or use config:
```
serving:
  kv_cache:
    enabled: true
    preserve_prefix_layout: false
```

dev-bot: quickpack job submitted id=7789 :gear:

qa-robot: quickpack finished. Summary:
- prompts: 60 (short decode-heavy + 5 long-context cases)
- pass threshold: coherence >= 0.78
- passed: 52/60
- avg token delta vs base: +1.2 tokens
- ngram score delta: -0.9
- hallucination alerts: increased on 4 prompts (from 3.1% -> 6.7%)

qa-robot: sample failure log:
```
PROMPT idx 19: repeats factual claim twice, then hallucinates citation.
MODEL LOG: dropped kv alignment at step 8, generated repetition
SCORE: coherence 0.51 (threshold 0.78)
```

maria: 52/60 is a yellow flag. @sam please do targeted rerun on the 8 failing prompts and try stitch merge with PRESERVE_ROPE_SCALE=1.02. Note stitch will increase mem and latency.

sam: Rerun notes:
- stitch + rope scale env applied
- rerun 8 -> 7 passed
- hallucination rate for rerun set: dropped from 6.7% -> 3.8%
- memory: +11% peak
- latency p95: +10%

chris: OK let's make stitch the recommended merge for Pegasus. Also run a short perplexity sweep to check quantization impact:
```
python infra/eval/perplexity_sweep.py --model merged_pegasus_stitch_4bit --dataset hf:hellaswag --out /tmp/perp_1800123456.json
```

qa-robot: perplexity sweep complete. Perp delta vs base: +3.1 — within expected for 4-bit. No extreme per-example spikes.

maria: Final action items:
- sam: upload merged artifact to s3 as merged_pegasus_stitch_4bit.safetensors and add metadata file with merge_method=stitch, rope_scale=1.02, quant=4bit
- chris: update adapter README with stitch recommendation, memory + latency notes, and required env vars
- anika: add a failing-case to the customer's smoke pack to catch kv/prefix truncation
- ops: schedule a 5% canary staging deploy after artifact upload
- support-bot: open customer-facing note explaining expected perf/latency tradeoffs

support-bot: created internal ticket CS-2146 (Pegasus adapter onboarding) :spiral_note_pad:

maria: thanks all — closing thread unless staging shows new regressions. :white_check_mark:
